provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C35 release-verification contract. It contains no production private key, published signature or customer data. Test keys are generated per run.

trust.fingerprint: sha256 over the raw 32-byte public key
trust.production_key_note: No production key or published fingerprint is created by C35. Maintainer-authorized publication and key distribution remain C40.
trust.validity: issued_at/expires_at are enforced for new installs and upgrades; already accepted attestations are re-verified without an expiry gate during rollback
trust.revision: positive monotonic release revision; stale or replayed revisions cannot replace the last accepted authority
trust.dirty_source: a dirty provenance tree is reported as a source_dirty warning and is not presented as a releasable publication

signature.signature_bytes: 64-byte Ed25519 signature encoded as canonical base64

install_layout.data: <prefix>/data or --data-dir (created mode 0700 only when absent; never written afterwards)
install_layout.activation: atomic install-state replacement; installed bytes are re-verified before activation
install_layout.engine_check: installed dist/engine/miragemesh --version must match the signed version when the host platform matches the artifact; the synthetic C35 upgrade fixture ships a declared fixture engine because the reviewed source pins the engine version to 0.0.1

upgrade_policy.already_accepted_release: may be reactivated after rollback when its signed digest is unchanged
upgrade_policy.idempotent: same current release and signed digest returns idempotent without rewriting state or data
upgrade_policy.data_directory: read-only compatibility check; upgrade never copies, rewrites or rolls back accepted data

rollback.data_schema_newer: refused when the store manifest schema exceeds the target release's signed data.store_schema

observed_run.artifact: miragemesh-0.0.1-linux-amd64 from the current source tree

limits: The repository ships no production release key, published signature or published artifact; C40 remains the authorized publication and installed full-workflow gate.

The C35 verification host was windows/amd64; the signed artifact contract declares linux-amd64. Install/upgrade/rollback file and data-safety semantics were exercised locally, while the installed linux engine and full Go storage suite require a supported Linux host.
The data-safety test uses repository-authored C05 manifest fixtures, not customer data. C05/C30 remain the durable-store authorities.
No hosted Actions run or remote release verification is claimed.
